parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the device that you want to query.

You can view the device information in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view the product information in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).
